title: Normalized reindexing of a finite total tensor
statement:
theorem podReindexingFiniteTensorComparison
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] (n : ℕ)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ)
    (P' Q' : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E X) ℤ)
    (a : (isoReductionFiniteComplex l E g n).obj
        ((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj P) ≅
      (unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E X n).obj P')
    (b : (isoReductionFiniteComplex l E g n).obj
        ((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj Q) ≅
      (unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E X n).obj Q') :
    ∃ e : (isoReductionIntegralComplex l E g).obj
        ((integralOperationsTensorLevel l E Y n).obj (P, Q)) ≅
      (integralOperationsTensorLevel l E X n).obj (P', Q'),
    ∀ (p q : ℤ) (U : X.ProEt)
      (x : (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj P).X p).val.obj
        (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U)))
      (y : (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj Q).X q).val.obj
        (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U))),
      ((e.hom.f (p + q)).val.app (op U))
          (integralOperationsTotalTensorSection l E Y n P Q p q
            (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U)) x y) =
        integralOperationsTotalTensorSection l E X n P' Q' p q (op U)
          ((a.hom.f p).val.app (op U) x) ((b.hom.f q).val.app (op U) y)

source.place: Steps 1 and 5; ordinary finite tensor comparison before strict tower transition compatibility.

proof.text: Use the finite closed structure and K-flat tensor model from the coefficient evaluation calculus to instantiate the existing tensor-chain comparison data at some n. Its pure-tensor formula fixes the finite chain map. The coefficient normalization equates its coefficient isomorphism with the constant-section isomorphism defining isoReductionFiniteComplex; transport the entire normalized assertion along this equality of coefficient isomorphisms.

Use the projection-normalized restriction-of-scalars square to identify the completed reindexing of the restricted finite tensor with the restriction of its finite reindexing. Lift this square to complexes, then compose with the finite tensor-chain isomorphism and with the total tensor of the two given chain isomorphisms a and b.

Identify the module-sheafification unit with the underlying abelian-sheafification unit, so the coefficient tensor generator equals integralOperationsTotalTensorSection. The restriction comparison acts identically on sections. Its equation, tensorChain_pure, and the total tensor map generator formula give the required composite equation. All components are isomorphisms, including at n=0 and for zero complexes.
